name: SmartPlay
description: SmartPlay is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models as intelligent agents through a suite of 6 different games, each testing specific agent capabilities such as reasoning, planning, spatial reasoning, learning from history, and understanding randomness. It provides up to 20 evaluation settings with infinite environment variations, enabling detailed analysis of LLM agent abilities.
reputation: A relatively new academic benchmark from the agentic-LLM literature that has seen limited but notable use for studying planning and reasoning in game-like environments.
notes: Includes 6 games with unique settings and challenges targeting 9 key intelligent agent capabilities.
